reference.title: Product B: Common Adverse Reactions
reference.shortdesc: Summary of clinical trial and post-marketing common adverse reactions observed with Product B.

section.title: Summary of Common Adverse Reactions for Product B
section.p: Clinically common adverse reactions occurred in ≥ 5% of patients of Product B include:

ul.li: Hypotension (Systolic BP < 90 mmHg): Occurred in 18% of patients (Mild to Moderate severity).
Bradycardia (< 50 bpm): Occurred in 12% of patients (Moderate severity).
Headache: Occurred in 9% of patients (Mild severity).
Dizziness / Lightheadedness: Occurred in 7% of patients (Mild severity).

section.title: Internal Review Notes
section.p: These notes are intended for internal regulatory review and should not be included in patient-facing materials.
Adverse reaction data is based on clinical trial populations; post-marketing surveillance may yield additional insights.
Ensure that all adverse reaction frequencies are updated in accordance with the latest clinical trial data and post-marketing reports.
